Who I Am

\r\n

\r\n My name is Travis Bickle. I’m a former Marine, now driving a cab in New York City.\r\n

\r\n
\r\n\r\n
\r\n

Why I Drive

\r\n

\r\n I have trouble sleeping, so I work long nights behind the wheel. The streets give me somewhere to go.\r\n

\r\n
\r\n\r\n
\r\n

What I See

\r\n

\r\n From my cab, I watch people come and go. I’m surrounded by a city full of life, but I still feel alone.\r\n
